title: QA Lead - Quality Engineering & Automation
description:
Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh \| On\-site  
Experience: 6 \- 10 Years  
Employment: Full\-Time  
Company: Solutionara Private Limited  
Industry: IT Consulting \& Technology Services

**About Solutionara**

Solutionara is a U.S.\-based IT Consulting and Technology Services firm with a Global Delivery Center in Noida, India.

As a fast\-scaling consulting firm, we operate with high ownership, lean teams, and disciplined execution. We are also evolving toward an AI\-enabled delivery model, focused on enterprise integration, digital transformation, and scalable technology solutions for global clients.

Our GDC plays a critical role in building high\-impact engineering and delivery teams while driving operational excellence through structured processes and intelligent automation.

**Role Overview**

Solutionara is looking for a QA Lead – Quality Engineering \& Automation to lead quality engineering activities across enterprise application, integration, cloud, data, and digital transformation engagements.

This is a hands\-on QA leadership role. The individual will be expected to provide technical and delivery leadership to QA engineers while remaining actively involved in test strategy, manual/functional testing, test automation, API testing, defect analysis, release validation, and quality governance.

The QA Lead will work closely with Project Managers, Technical Project Managers, Solution Architects, Developers, DevOps Engineers, Integration Engineers, Product/Business teams, and client stakeholders to ensure quality is built into the delivery lifecycle rather than treated only as a final testing activity.

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable developing an automation framework, reviewing test scenarios, investigating a production defect, coordinating UAT/release readiness, and guiding QA team members.

**What You’ll Do**

**QA Leadership \& Quality Ownership**

* Own QA planning and execution across assigned projects and releases.
* Define the overall test strategy, test approach, scope, estimates, environments, entry/exit criteria, and quality gates.
* Lead and guide QA engineers across manual and automation testing activities.
* Review test plans, test scenarios, test cases, automation coverage, defect reports, and testing evidence.
* Assign and coordinate QA activities based on project priorities, release schedules, dependencies, and team capacity.
* Mentor QA team members and support development of stronger testing, automation, and analytical capabilities.
* Partner with Project Managers and engineering leads to identify quality risks early and establish appropriate mitigation plans.
* Provide clear visibility into testing progress, defect trends, blockers, release risks, and overall product quality.
* Promote accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the QA function.

**Manual \& Functional Testing**

* Remain hands\-on with functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, smoke, sanity, and end\-to\-end testing where required.
* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
* Validate complex workflows across web applications, APIs, integrations, databases, and enterprise systems.
* Perform positive, negative, boundary, exception, and data\-validation testing.
* Validate cross\-browser and responsive application behavior where applicable.
* Identify gaps and ambiguities in requirements before they become downstream defects.
* Ensure adequate regression coverage for releases and production changes.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test preparation, defect triage, validation, and business\-user coordination.

**Test Automation**

* Design, develop, maintain, and improve scalable test automation frameworks.
* Identify appropriate candidates for automation based on business criticality, repeatability, regression requirements, risk, and return on automation effort.
* Develop and maintain automated tests for web applications and APIs.
* Establish reusable automation components, coding standards, test\-data approaches, reporting, and framework best practices.
* Review automation code developed by QA engineers and provide technical guidance.
* Improve automation coverage while ensuring automated tests remain reliable, maintainable, and relevant.
* Diagnose and resolve flaky or unreliable automated tests.
* Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and faster release feedback.
* Track automation effectiveness and continuously identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual testing.

**API, Integration \& Data Validation**

* Perform functional and automated testing of REST APIs and service integrations.
* Validate request/response structures, status codes, authentication, error handling, business rules, and data integrity.
* Use tools such as Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, or equivalent API testing tools.
* Validate data across application, API, integration, and database layers using SQL where appropriate.
* Test system\-to\-system workflows, asynchronous processes, interfaces, and third\-party integrations.
* Work with Integration and Development teams to identify failures across APIs, middleware, applications, databases, and external dependencies.
* Validate error handling, retry behavior, exception scenarios, and recovery processes.

**Defect Management \& Root Cause Analysis**

* Own disciplined defect lifecycle management from identification through closure.
* Ensure defects contain appropriate evidence, reproducible steps, severity/priority, environment details, and business impact.
* Lead or participate in defect triage discussions with engineering, product, delivery, and client teams.
* Distinguish between application defects, test\-data issues, environment problems, integration failures, and requirement gaps.
* Perform defect trend analysis and identify recurring quality issues.
* Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major defects and production incidents.
* Work with engineering teams to ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented where appropriate.

**Release \& Production Quality**

* Support QA readiness across development, QA, UAT, staging, and production environments.
* Assess testing completeness and provide evidence\-based recommendations on release readiness.
* Ensure critical defects and known risks are clearly communicated before production deployment.
* Participate in release planning, cutover, deployment validation, smoke testing, and post\-release verification.
* Support production incident investigation and defect reproduction when required.
* Maintain appropriate traceability between requirements, testing, defects, and release outcomes.

**Quality Governance \& Reporting**

* Establish practical QA standards, templates, checklists, and testing processes appropriate for a growing technology services organization.
* Track relevant quality metrics including test execution, pass/fail trends, defect leakage, defect aging, severity distribution, automation coverage, regression results, and release quality.
* Provide concise QA status reporting to Project Managers, Delivery Leadership, and other stakeholders.
* Identify emerging quality risks early rather than waiting until the end of the testing cycle.
* Participate in project governance and release\-readiness discussions.
* Help standardize QA practices across projects while allowing appropriate flexibility based on technology and client requirements.

**AI\-Assisted Quality Engineering**

* Use approved AI\-assisted tools to improve productivity across test\-case development, test\-data preparation, automation development, defect analysis, documentation, and test coverage analysis.
* Evaluate opportunities to use AI to identify testing gaps and improve regression coverage.
* Encourage responsible use of AI\-assisted engineering tools while maintaining appropriate review, security, confidentiality, and quality controls.
* Explore practical ways to improve QA efficiency without compromising engineering rigor or test effectiveness.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* 6–10 years of overall software quality assurance / quality engineering experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading QA activities or providing technical leadership to QA engineers.
* Strong hands\-on experience in both manual testing and test automation.
* Experience defining test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, estimates, and release\-quality criteria.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Strong experience with functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Hands\-on experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or comparable technologies.
* Programming/scripting capability using Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or another relevant automation language.
* Strong API testing experience using Postman, REST Assured, Playwright API testing, or equivalent tools.
* Working knowledge of SQL and ability to perform database/data validation.
* Experience with defect and test\-management platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray, or comparable tools.
* Understanding of Git/version control and CI/CD concepts.
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience troubleshooting defects across application, API, integration, database, and environment layers.
* Strong understanding of defect management, severity/priority classification, RCA, regression strategy, and release validation.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum and/or hybrid delivery environments.
* Ability to work effectively with developers, architects, DevOps engineers, business analysts, project managers, and client stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to balance hands\-on execution with team leadership and delivery accountability.

**Technical Fluency**

The QA Lead is not expected to function as a software architect, but should possess sufficient technical depth to understand and test modern enterprise solutions involving:

* Web and responsive applications
* REST/SOAP APIs
* Microservices and distributed applications
* Third\-party and enterprise integrations
* Relational and NoSQL databases
* Cloud\-hosted applications, preferably AWS and/or Azure
* Authentication, authorization, RBAC, OAuth/JWT, and application security concepts
* CI/CD and DevOps workflows
* Development, QA, UAT, staging, and production environments
* Event\-driven and asynchronous workflows
* Logs, monitoring, incidents, and Root Cause Analysis
* Deployment, release, rollback, and production\-support processes

The individual should be able to understand what is being tested, where a failure is occurring, its likely technical layer, its business impact, and what evidence engineering teams need to diagnose it.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within IT consulting, technology services, or Global Delivery Center (GDC) environments.
* Experience supporting U.S. or other global clients and distributed engineering teams.
* Experience testing enterprise applications, cloud solutions, APIs, integrations, data platforms, digital commerce, PIM/DAM, ERP, CRM, or similar enterprise technology solutions.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or equivalent.
* Exposure to basic application security testing and OWASP concepts.
* Experience with AWS and/or Azure environments.
* Experience with Docker/containerized applications.
* Experience with integration platforms, middleware, Boomi, API management, or event\-driven systems is advantageous.
* Experience establishing or improving QA processes within a growing engineering organization.
* Experience with AI\-assisted development/testing tools such as GitHub Copilot or comparable solutions.
* Relevant QA/testing certifications are beneficial but not mandatory.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means:

* Quality is considered from requirements and design through production, not only during the final testing phase.
* QA risks and testing dependencies are identified early.
* Manual testing is disciplined and focused on scenarios requiring human judgment and exploratory validation.
* Automation coverage grows strategically rather than simply increasing the number of automated scripts.
* Regression testing becomes faster and more reliable.
* Automated tests are maintainable and integrated into delivery pipelines.
* Defects contain actionable technical evidence and are triaged efficiently.
* Critical defects are identified before production.
* QA provides objective evidence for release\-readiness decisions.
* Production defect leakage and recurring quality issues are actively reduced.
* QA engineers receive appropriate technical direction, mentoring, and accountability.
* Project and delivery leadership have clear visibility into quality, testing progress, risks, and release readiness.
* The QA Lead remains sufficiently hands\-on technically to challenge assumptions, investigate problems, and guide the team, rather than functioning only as a QA coordinator.

**Additional Information**

* Immediate joiners are strongly preferred.
* Candidates based in or near Noida Sector 62 (Delhi NCR) are preferred.
* Level 1 of the selection process is an AI\-conducted web interview.

We invite you to join our team! Learn more at careers.alight.com.  

  

About the Team


Our Network Architecture \& Engineering (A\&E) team owns the technology standards, reference architectures, and first\-build execution for all network and network\-security infrastructure across the organization. We operate fully remote across US time zones and are now extending globally to support the company's expansion into India. This hire is the first member of that global extension.


A\&E sits above operations: we design and execute the first build of every major network deployment, then hand off to NOC and operational teams. We also serve as Tier 3 escalation for complex technology problems that NOC cannot resolve within standard runbooks.

------------------


As Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer — India, you will be the hands\-on execution anchor for our India office buildouts and the primary Tier 3 escalation resource for India\-based NOC staff during India business hours. You will commission greenfield office networks to corporate standards, own in\-country vendor and contractor coordination, and work directly alongside the US\-based A\&E team to extend our delivery capability across time zones.

You will implement and operationalize solutions designed by the A\&E team, identify gaps during deployment, and feed ground\-truth feedback back into standards. You will be expected to act with a high degree of autonomy in\-country while remaining closely aligned with US team direction.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Office Network Deployment \& Standards**

* Commission greenfield office networks across India locations, including MDF/IDF build\-out to corporate standards
* Deploy and configure Aruba wireless (APs, controllers, Aruba Central) and Aruba switching infrastructure
* Implement and validate SilverPeak (Aruba EdgeConnect) SD\-WAN at each India site, including connectivity back to AWS US\-East where corporate assets reside
* Manage local in\-country challenges specific to India office builds — ISP coordination, last\-mile issues, regulatory compliance, and vendor/contractor oversight
* Maintain and enforce IDF/MDF physical and logical standards across all India locations

 **Client\-Side \& Security Stack Execution**

* Execute and validate Zscaler ZIA and ZDX deployments for India user populations
* Ensure Zscaler ZDX synthetic monitoring is in place and baselined for all India offices
* Support Infoblox DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) implementation and ongoing integrity in India office environments
* Work with the US team to onboard India sites into Kentik for observability, traffic visibility, and synthetic monitoring

 **Tier 3 Escalation Support**

* Serve as the A\&E Tier 3 escalation point for India NOC staff during India business hours — on\-demand, no formal rotation
* Handle escalated technology problems outside standard NOC runbooks, primarily oriented around: Firewall policy and troubleshooting, WAF configuration and incident response, Proxy (Zscaler ZIA) issues requiring A\&E\-level depth
* Document resolution steps and feed durable fixes back into NOC runbooks and A\&E standards

 **Automation \& Infrastructure as Code**

* Apply IaC practices (Terraform, Git) to network provisioning and configuration management in line with US team standards
* Contribute Python automation for operational tasks, configuration validation, and network telemetry
* Participate in CI/CD pipeline workflows using GitHub, CodeCommit, and CodePipeline as used by the broader A\&E team

 **Cross\-Team Collaboration**

* Coordinate with US\-based A\&E architects to translate designs into India\-specific deployments
* Provide ground\-truth feedback from in\-country deployments to inform and improve corporate network standards
* Travel to India office locations as required throughout the year for site evaluations, buildouts, and audits

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 7\+ years of hands\-on enterprise network engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead execution role
* Strong working knowledge of Aruba wireless and switching platforms (Aruba Central, APs, CX/AOS\-S switching)
* Hands\-on experience with SD\-WAN — SilverPeak (Aruba EdgeConnect) strongly preferred; comparable platform experience (Cisco Viptela, Versa, VeloCloud) considered
* Production experience with Zscaler ZIA and ZDX — deployment, policy management, and troubleshooting strongly preferred
* Solid foundation in enterprise routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, VLAN architecture, QoS)
* Experience commissioning office networks including physical MDF/IDF build\-out, structured cabling coordination, and ISP turn\-up
* Demonstrated ability to work independently across time zones with minimal daily supervision — this role reports to a US\-based manager
* Strong written and spoken English — cross\-functional communication with US stakeholders is a daily requirement

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Certifications: CCNP Enterprise, Aruba Certified Mobility Professional (ACMP), Zscaler Certified Associate / Professional, or equivalent
* Experience with Kentik for network visibility, monitoring, and synthetic testing
* Familiarity with AWS networking (VPC, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway) — AWS US\-East is the corporate connectivity target for India sites
* Prior experience deploying networks in India specifically — understanding of local ISP landscape, data center options, and in\-country compliance considerations
* Experience with Palo Alto firewalls, AWS WAF, or Next\-Generation Firewall platforms relevant to Tier 3 escalation work
* Working knowledge of Infoblox DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) in enterprise office deployments
* Python scripting and infrastructure\-as\-code experience (Terraform, Git) applied to network configuration and automation
* Jira for project tracking and documentation

**Core Technology Stack**
-------------------------


Candidates should come in with hands\-on depth in the majority of the following:

* Wireless \& Switching: Aruba (Central, APs, CX switching)
* SD\-WAN: SilverPeak / Aruba EdgeConnect
* SASE / Proxy: Zscaler ZIA, ZDX

Candidates based in or near Noida or Gurgaon are strongly preferred given current office concentration in the NCR region.

description:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated **IoT Engineer** to design, develop, and maintain IoT solutions, including connected devices, sensors, embedded systems, and PCB\-based hardware. The candidate will work on hardware design, firmware development, and cloud integration to build reliable and scalable IoT applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and implement IoT solutions using sensors, microcontrollers, and connected devices.
* **Design and develop PCBs for IoT devices, including schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout.**
* **Create and modify PCB designs using tools such as Altium Designer, KiCad, Eagle, or similar software.**
* **Perform PCB routing, component placement, and design optimization for signal integrity, power management, and manufacturability.**
* **Prepare Gerber files, BOMs, and other manufacturing documentation for PCB fabrication and assembly.**
* Develop and integrate firmware for IoT devices using platforms such as ESP32, Arduino, or Raspberry Pi.
* Work with communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP, BLE, Wi\-Fi, and LoRaWAN.
* Develop and integrate APIs for communication between IoT devices and cloud platforms.
* Configure and manage IoT platforms, databases, and cloud services.
* Collect, process, and analyze data received from connected devices.
* Perform hardware testing, PCB debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Collaborate with software, hardware, and product development teams.
* Ensure IoT systems are secure, reliable, and scalable.
* Prepare technical documentation, system designs, and project reports.
* Stay updated with emerging IoT and embedded hardware technologies.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of IoT architecture and connected\-device technologies.
* **Experience in PCB design, schematic capture, and PCB layout.**
* **Proficiency in PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, KiCad, Eagle, or similar.**
* **Understanding of electronic components, circuit design, power supplies, and signal routing.**
* Experience with embedded systems and microcontrollers.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as **C, C\+\+, Python, or JavaScript**.
* Understanding of communication protocols such as **MQTT, HTTP, and REST APIs**.
* Knowledge of databases such as **MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB**.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as **AWS IoT, Azure IoT, or Google Cloud**.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Good communication and teamwork abilities.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
